summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only regression + 4 new features. All PASS. (1) Session Targets: target-free/10/20/30 (squats) and target-free/30/45/60 (plank) chips render + highlight correctly; running HUD shows 'reps / target' format ('REPS 0 / 10'). (2) Spoken Coach toggle (settings-voice-toggle) flips settings.voice in localStorage true<->false with no errors; settings-sound-toggle still works. (3) Export via export-data-btn produces a downloaded JSON file (bits-in-motion-<date>.json) — download event captured. (4) Import via import-file-input with a valid BITS backup replaces profile+history (verified in localStorage and History nav shows imported counts 42 & 60); invalid JSON triggers 'Invalid backup file' sonner toast and does NOT crash. Rep-smoothing/no-crash regression: HUD renders (rep-counter-display, phase-badge, form-cue, form-ring, finish-workout-btn); finish-workout-btn returns to dashboard with 'Nothing to log yet' info toast (expected because static fake webcam produces 0 reps). Onboarding→dashboard persistence across reload still works. No runtime errors from smoothProgRef / maxProgRef / lastRepAtRef.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer still logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on initial paint. Cosmetic — carried over from iteration 1.

AppContext.replaceAll defensively merges defaults; settings.voice default is false in storage.js — matches spec.
speech.js gracefully no-ops when speechSynthesis is unavailable and wraps in try/catch.
